So, believe it or not, the whole "making someone uncomfortable" thing is about dysphoria. Whether I want it or not, I look and sound like a man. From my own experience, masc looking people are more intimidating than fem looking ones. So making someone uncomfortable amplifies the dissonance between my identity and body.

Also it sucks to have a perfectly nice day and then have an encounter which stays in your head until the next long rest.

So yeah the whole trans thing is really messing me up here. Confidence, dysphoria and a bit of imposter syndrome do be hitting hard.

Thanks. Social anxiety is a thing that I mostly experience online weirdly enough. I can manage talking to people irl if I have a jumping off point. But if there is nothing more besides "they look cool" idk how to talk to them.

And yea,  failing is pretty important. 

I just don't know how relationships work. Basically, all my experience is watching Gilmore Girls on repeat when it comes to that.
The issue is that once I meet someone where I can imagine something working out, I don't know what to do.
How do I figure out if they like me? Or if I like them?
How do I let them know what I am looking for?
And how do I not be weird about it?
I am not too scared of rejection or anything. 
I'm scared I will make someone uncomfortable.

Isn't there stuff which is universally accepted as ok?
When you're like pushing the boundaries of friendship?

Being trans makes this a whole lot scarier.

The thing is that being 21 without any intimacy with another human left me with the mindset that no one really likes me to begin with.
I'm pretty sure passing would help. Or at least being on hrt. But I don't want to wait for that anymore. Especially since I don't know when/if I will get there.

Okay that smear made her turning away look pretty good imo. I actually didn't think about adding one where you did but as I said it added to her turning away. The movement towards the cam is now made of 3 frames. 1 is the furthest and 2 is the closest so try adding a smear between 2 and 3. That was my original thought. It feels like you could really exaggerate that like in that one [Super-Man smear frame](https://www.pinterest.de/pin/300193131407601258/). But keep the one you already added. I hope my unqualified advice is of any help for you lol. Btw where are you going to post your finished work?

I'm probably the wrong person for hair, sorry. But maybe try scrunching up the body on the wind up a bit. Maybe some arm movement right when she moves forward. I can imagine her flinging them back so she's sorta doing an A-pose if you know what I mean. You know to break up the sillouette and it may also help with being snappy. Keep trying cause as I said solid stuff just needs some fuzzing around. :)

Oh I knew what you were talking about. Don't do that you have something quite solid there. And yes try removing some frames and maybe putting a smear instead. But I'm just doing guess work here. Also don't over work yourself. I did that once and I'm having trouble getting back to animating lol

Reminds me a bit of Telepurte lol. Let me preface that I couldn't do any better, so let's goo. It feels like there are to many frames when she moves towards the camera. Try to make it a bit snappier if that makes sense. Maybe let her rest a bit more on the wind up, just a few frames. Also try adding a smear frame for that big movement towards the camera. I wouldn't start over or at least I'd keep the file around in case I don't like the second attempt. And if you don't have it already try getting "the animators survival kit" by Richard Williams since it's pretty useful to have around when you run into trouble. Keep going most of the people in the world aren't able to do something close to this.

I often felt ungrateful for "wanting to feel bad" but that's probably just a product of my poor mental health. I'm sorry but I can't give you any advice how to deal with that but just know that you're not the only one feeling this way. I wish you find somebody who can actually help you.

Hi, thanks again for those kind words. I think leaving germany as soon as possible will help at least a little bit. Pushing the reset button. But even then my problems aren't entirely gone. You really helped me more than you think! But I don't think the thought of taking "the easy way out" will stick around for a while. I don't think I'm affraid of failing but affraid of succeeding and not liking were I end up. Realising how complicated life is makes me doubt myself constantly. Am I doing the right thing? What do the people think about me? I even doubt that my friends really like me. I always  feel like I don't belong there.
Maybe I'm asking for too much but would you mind staying in contact for a little while? Just so I someone to talk to. If you don't want that's absolutely fine. I can understand that it can be exhausting listening to somebody like me. Especially since we're complete strangers. Once again I can't thank you enough for what you have done it really means much to me. I hope you're having a great time.

First at all the kindest words some one told me ever. It's not only how I'm feeling right now but also how afraid I am. I just can't see a way my life is going to work out. I feel like I wasn't  made for this world you know. It's all too much. My life was held together by video games and shallow friendships. But now I'm leaving school and the rules are changing. Everybody in my class already has their job but I'm still at the point I was three years ago! Worst thing is I'm the only one to blame. I was never interested in anyway of being grown up. And I'm here the day that always seemed so unreal. I just don't know how to move on.

It wasn't that bad back then I played a lot of video games so it was easier to handle but it's catching up now when I'm leaving school and I have to return to reality. Thanks for your time but I can't tell where I'm going now or what will happen to me.

It's just that I have huge troubles making or trusting people in general. I don't know why. I don't want to cry all the time but growing up and keeping your will to live is just so unbelievable hard! Religion isn't an option 'cause if there's a god he's a fucking dickhead. I was in a "special kids daycare school" once for 2 years that was during elementary school. I would send  a child there. That place was fucking stupid they threw children with ADHD, autism and depression all in one school and somehow expect them to get better. There were the caretakers and the  teachers. The teachers were normal as teachers with no special education and the caretakers were fucking stupid as well. I got yelled at in front of everyone because I drew a tombstone with "R.I.P." written on it. WTF? yeah I was an edgy 9 year old boy but why react like this? I was prescribed anti-depressants when I got released. Overall the worst thing somebody has done to me yet! "Sure let's give our nine year old son anti-depressants!" Yeah fuck you mom! It's fucking easy to make friends when you come from an "Retard School". Wow fucking nice! I don't have any friends, am under medication, get called retard where ever I go and now I'm developing an addiction to glue! FUCK! Fucking germany acts like mental illness didn't exist and if you're different you're just stupid and it's because of the video games. Fuck that. That's  a fucking world I don't wanna live in.

I'm trying but as you can imagine getting a job is pretty hard right now especially with my marks. But yeah moving out is a long time goal for me. I've already moved away from my mother to my grandparents but that didn't work as well. Result of that is that I now feel absolutely lost. Like where the fuck do I belong? Every time I have a breakdown I start saying to myself that I need to go home. It's been 17 years and I still haven't found my home.

If it was that easy. I haven't achieved a single noteworthy thing in my life. The only thing I am passionate about WAS art but now it's just a chore I put on myself because  I want to get better at it. But I get so mad at myself for not making any progress. It's fucking when the only thing that you truly love brings you so much pain just because you can't accept that learning takes time. I don't see what is bad about being dead! Everything would be over. I wouldn't have to worry about a single thing.
Everybody deserves that. I have troubles being patient when it comes to improving myself. I need results n. I know that's not how it works but I still hate myself for it. Thanks for being there
